transformation_rule: D-026. Headline: share of annual nights in the 3 busiest months (EU Tourism Dashboard TOUR_SOE_02 definition), computed over ALL accommodation from Eurostat tour_occ_nin2m monthly nights for EL62 and EL, 2020-2025: top3_share = sum(3 largest monthly nights) / sum(12 monthly nights) * 100 (EL62 2023 = 63.81 %). Seasonality Index: Gini coefficient of the 12 monthly nights (EL62 2023 = 0.5827). Context: peak-month share, share of nights outside June-September, and EL62 monthly nights. Computed by scripts/verification/compute-data29-seasonality.py, which first checks the definition against the dashboard: EL 2021-2023 match on all accommodation; EL62 2020-2023 match only on online-platform nights (tour_ce_omn12). The dashboard EL62 value (71.08 % in 2023) is therefore kept as a separate platform-only series.

refined_data.results.<geo>.<year>.top3_s.description: Headline Data29: share of annual nights (all accommodation) in the 3 busiest months. EL62 2023 = 63.81.

refined_data.results.<geo>.<year>.gini.description: Seasonality Index: Gini coefficient of the 12 monthly nights; 0 = even year-round, 0.917 = all nights in one month. EL62 2023 = 0.5827.

refined_data.results.<geo>.<year>.peak_m.description: Share of annual nights in the single busiest month (August in every year).

refined_data.results.<geo>.<year>.share_.description: Share of annual nights in January-May and October-December; tracks off-season growth.

refined_data.results.<geo>.<year>.monthl.description: Monthly nights M01..M12 from tour_occ_nin2m (all accommodation, I551-I553).

refined_data.results.EL62.<year>.platfor.description: Same measure over online-platform nights only (tour_ce_omn12); equals the dashboard TOUR_SOE_02 EL62 value.

refined_data.dashboard_reconciliation.description: Per geo/year: dashboard value, recomputed value, basis, match flag.

refined_data.dashboard_el62_platform_onl.description: EU Tourism Dashboard TOUR_SOE_02 EL62 2023 (71.08 %), relabelled as online-platform-only seasonality.

definition.headline: top3_share_pct: share of annual nights in the 3 busiest months, all accommodation (TOUR_SOE_02 definition)
definition.seasonality_index: gini: Gini coefficient of the 12 monthly nights counts

dashboard_reconciliation.note: known revision: probable Eurostat revision after the 2024 dashboard export

refined_data.dashboard_note: TOUR_SOE_02 for EL62 is computed from online-platform nights only (tour_ce_omn12); for EL it uses all accommodation. The EL62 dashboard value 71.08 (2023) is kept as a separate platform-only series; the headline here uses all accommodation.
caveats: 2020 and 2021 are distorted by COVID-19 restrictions.
EL 2020 does not reproduce the dashboard exactly (69.79 vs 70.09, +0.30 pp). Probably a Eurostat revision; tested with a 0.5 pp tolerance and recorded in dashboard_reconciliation.
Monthly totals are not normalised by days in month (Eurostat convention). Effect for EL62 2023: top-3 63.81 -> 63.59 per-day, Gini 0.5827 -> 0.5809 (DeepSeek review B4).
No accommodation-type split exists in tour_occ_nin2m at NUTS 2.
No monthly data exists for the NUTS 3 islands (tour_occ_nin3m, tour_ce_omn3: HTTP 404).
